content: The Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center School of Pharmacy, located on the Abilene Campus, officially commenced operations on August 12, 2007. The campus features a 36,000-square-foot facility designed with a Spanish architectural theme, which was constructed at a cost of $15.5 million USD. At the time of its opening, the school enrolled an initial cohort of 40 students. This enrollment was projected to increase to 160 students by the fall semester of 2011. Additionally, by that time, the institution anticipated employing 40 faculty members and staff to support its academic and operational needs. The Abilene Campus of the Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center School of Pharmacy offers a single professional degree program: the Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD).
